identityLock.coat: fluffy white coat with soft natural texture; not plush-toy texture
identityLock.face: large round dark eyes, small black nose, slightly cream-toned long muzzle/moustache fur
identityLock.body: compact small-dog proportions, short legs; keep realistic anatomy
avoid: changing facial markings or coat color between states

animationStates.idle: Relaxed resting/sitting idle. Subtle breathing, blinking, tiny head or ear motion. Clearly alive but calm.
animationStates.running-right: Duoduo runs toward screen-right with a natural small-dog gait. No speed lines or dust.
animationStates.running-left: Duoduo runs toward screen-left with the same identity and natural gait. No speed lines or dust.
animationStates.waving: Duoduo sits and lifts the right front paw in a cute greeting wave; keep canine anatomy.
animationStates.jumping: Happy compact hop with all four paws briefly off the ground, then landing-ready pose; no detached effects.
animationStates.failed: Duoduo lies flat or slumps sadly with droopy expression, looking disappointed but cute.
animationStates.waiting: Duoduo waits attentively. On the special gesture: right front paw moves from beside the right eye downward toward the neck/chest twice; left front paw stays still. Adapt the gesture naturally to dog anatomy.
animationStates.running: Codex working state: Duoduo happily eats or carries a small piece of bread/toast while staying mostly in place; this is NOT directional running.
animationStates.review: Duoduo carefully reviews/reads beside a small laptop or document; optional round glasses, focused expression.

optionalProps.raincoat: transparent raincoat with bright blue trim based on reference photo
optionalProps.laptop: small neutral laptop with no visible brand/logo
